description: Defines a template class TimerType for scheduling timed callbacks, including nested classes for managing timed info and worker threads, as well as a WatchDogType class for thread-based timeout handling.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class for scheduling timed callbacks with internal thread management.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: Holds scheduled time and content, with comparison operators.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimeWorker
classes.description: Thread class executing the timer process.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: Thread class for timeout handling with arm/reset functionality.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback at a specific time with content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all scheduled entries and blocks the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a callback at a specific time, replacing existing entries.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a specific content entry from schedule.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled entries.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for executing scheduled callbacks.
